fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami municipal elections and city finances, criticism of public-utility franchise arrangements involving Florida Power & Light, and discussion of law enforcement and Prohibition-era bootlegging. Coverage also addresses Miami Beach negotiations for a municipally owned golf course, calls for lower consumer prices (including bus fare), and a lengthy discussion of the local milk situation and pricing. Additional items include local civic and political notes, American Legion drum-and-bugle corps news, transportation advertising (Seaboard Air Line Railway), and commentary on Florida oil-boom rumors, along with society/entertainment and sports notices.
